svg.aria-label: What common organisms look like down the microscope: Gram-positive cocci in clusters (Staphylococcus aureus), lancet-shaped diplococci (Streptococcus pneumoniae), Gram-negative rods (E. coli), red acid-fast bacilli on blue with Ziehl-Neelsen (M. tuberculosis), Chinese-letter arrangement with volutin granules on Albert stain (C. diphtheriae), spirochaetes on dark ground (Treponema, Leptospira) and a clear capsule on India ink (Cryptococcus), with the four Gram stain steps.
svg.text: Shape, arrangement and stain identify the organism
